test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The Managing Director of the company launched the latest phone before the press.

options.text: The latest phone was launched by the press before the Managing Director of the company.
The latest phone has been launched by the Managing Director of the company before the press.
The Managing Director was launched by the latest phone of the company before the press.
The latest phone was launched by the Managing Director of the company before the press.

solution: The correct answer is** 'The latest phone was launched by the Managing Director of the company before the press.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. • The structure of the given sentence is as follows: • Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • *Example:* • *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)* • *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)* • The subject of the given sentence is 'The Managing Director of the company'.​​ • The object of the given sentence is 'the latest phone'. • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. • And 'launched' will be changed into 'was launched'. • Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added. **Correct Sentence:__** *The latest phone was launched by the Managing Director of the company before the press.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • ​दिया गया वाक्य Active Voice में है। दिए गए प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Passive Voice में बदलना है। • दिए गए वाक्य की संरचना इस प्रकार है: • Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice) • Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) • उदाहरण: • *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)* • *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)* • दिए गए वाक्य का विषय 'The Managing Director of the company' है।​ • दिए गए वाक्य का object 'the latest phone' है। • Object के स्थान पर Subject रखा जाएगा और Subject के स्थान पर Object रखा जाएगा। • 'launched' को 'was launched' में बदल दिया जाएगा। • अंत में, 'by' preposition जोड़ा जाएगा। a8:T1268, The correct answer is **'She said that the organisation had been established a year before.'**
